description: Fork of exp709 (untied vanilla MinimalGPT+RoPE, bs=48, 16K, FP32 storage+compute = 1.1922 @ 35.79M). Changes: (1) n_steps 16K -> 4K (cheap apples-to-apples comparison vs exp732/exp737 4K LUT runs at the same bs=48 budget); (2) actually apply bf16 autocast on the train forward/backward, since the existing `compute_dtype: bf16` flag was dead in exp709 (defined but never used). Fp32 master weights kept by PyTorch AdamW; only matmuls (including unembedder Linear(D, V)) run in bf16. Establishes the 4K bs=48 untied vanilla bf16 baseline for LUT-LM comparison (exp737 v2 = bf16 LUT storage + bf16 internal compute). Expected: small bpb regression vs the equivalent fp32 4K run (~5-15 mb). Wallclock ~9-10 min on H100. Note: 4K-step LR schedule shifts peak LR to step 400 vs 1600 in the 16K parent — direct val_bpb comparison to exp709@step4000 is INVALID (different schedule).
